verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents its own routing across multiple LLM models: load balancing, dynamic routing "based on various metrics," and semantic-similarity routing, which can steer requests by capability. The evidence does not explicitly show availability-based failover or cost-driven model switching as routing policies, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit failover/availability-based rerouting, documented cost-based routing rules, mid-task switching semantics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can switch models mid-task by policy — cost, capability, or availability — through gateway routing rules

citations.quote: AI Gateway provides load balancing capabilities to distribute requests across multiple LLM models.
Request routing can be dynamic, allowing AI usage to be optimized based on various metrics
AI Gateway can perform intelligent request routing, caching, and content filtering using semantic similarity queries.
